row.notes: Returns a body's particle list (param_2+8..+0x10, ptr per entry) to the pool: for each ptr finds its slot in mgr+0x30 (stride 400), resets particle (pos +0x70/+0x80/+0xc0 = rest +0xb0, vel +0xa0/+0xd0/+0xe0 = 0, identity matrix +0x30..+0x68, +0x178 = +0x170), sets free flag mgr+0x50[i] = 1, adds count to mgr+0xac0, logs 'Successfully released %I64u particles. There are now %I64u free particles.', clears list. Returns 0 or 0x16 (EINVAL) for an empty list. | #587: L2 by lead-authorised promotion for lane owner car-re (independent agree V2313)

verify.notes: V2313 Verified incl. reset fields, free flag, count add, list cleared, 0x16 if empty.
